_comment: Limits for REAL Binance USDⓈ-M Futures (both directions). Owner, 2026-10-10: risk 1-15% of equity per trade (scaled by the signal's quality, never by past results), each position up to 50% of equity, all positions within the free margin at 1x; loss limit 45% (band 20-50%) with a 2 USD warning; goal +58%; windows 07-10 / 17-19 Ecuador every 2 min, every 5 outside, 24/7; stops 3-15% from the market. At 1x with a 50% cap and a 15% stop, one trade loses at most 7.5% of equity. Changing any value requires his written approval. Withdrawals and transfers are done only by the owner, never by the system.
